name: regreview
description: AI pre-inspection review for FDA-regulated design and quality records

scripts.//typecheck:web: apps/web is deliberately not a root project reference (it is not composite; Vite owns its build), so its types are checked by this separate pass. It is chained into build/typecheck because an unreferenced, never-invoked check is the same as no check — two type errors sat undetected in RunReview.tsx until someone ran it by hand. `vite build` will NOT catch these: esbuild strips types without checking them.
scripts.//: Workspaces import @regreview/core via its dist output, so core is built first. tsc -b is incremental, so this is a no-op once warm.
scripts.//review: Run from the repo root so --env-file-if-exists finds ./.env and the CLI's relative imports resolve. --env-file-if-exists (not --env-file) so a missing .env is not an error.
scripts.//db-scripts: Every script below that touches a database is invoked via `node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx <path>` directly from the repo root, rather than `npm run -w`, which changes cwd to the sub-workspace before --env-file-if-exists can find ./.env. The three NEON_*_DATABASE_URL vars have no fallback (unlike the old local SQLite path), so this is not optional anymore.
scripts.ingest:cfr: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/corpus/src/cli/ingestCfr.ts
scripts.ingest:guidance: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus ingest:guidance
scripts.corpus:report: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/corpus/src/cli/report.ts
scripts.severity:check: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/corpus/src/cli/severityCheck.ts
scripts.eval: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/eval/src/cli/runEval.ts
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch --import tsx apps/server/src/index.ts
scripts.diff:runs: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/corpus/src/cli/diffRuns.ts
scripts.rules:report: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/corpus/src/cli/rulesReport.ts
scripts.facts:report: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/corpus/src/cli/factsReport.ts
scripts.ledger:demo: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/core/src/cli/changeLedger.ts
scripts.graph:demo: npm run build:core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx packages/core/src/cli/graphDemo.ts
